name: Disguise
description: This Pokemon wears a convincing disguise of another Pokemon. If it receives damage, the disguise will break, making it appear as if it received a fatal injury.
effect: The first time the User would receive damage by another mon, reduce that damage to zero. Hazards, Weather and Status Ailments do not activate this Ability. This Ability cannot be copied, replaced or nullified (ignoring the effects of Skill Swap, Worry Seed, Gastro Acid, Trace etc.)
